notice.readOnly: Read-only: editing from the dashboard is turned off (DASHBOARD_EDIT_ENABLED is not true).
notice.viewOnly: View only: you need Administrator in the main server to change role rules.

form.name: Name
form.thresholdHint: Days in the server (0 = on joining, up to {maxDays}) or the leveling level (1–{maxLevel}). Not used for "Has a role".
form.giveHint: Only roles below Mewvo (and below your own top role), not managed, without staff permissions.
form.removeWhenFalse: Take the role away again when the condition is no longer true
form.removeHelp: Taking away also applies to members who got the role by hand; a member still matched by another enabled rule for the same role keeps it.
form.enabled: Turn the rule on when saving
form.nothingYet: Nothing changes yet: the next page shows how many members, and who, the rule would change.

rules.title: Role rules
rules.intro: Roles Mewvo gives by itself: checked every 10 minutes (at most {limit} role changes per run, one at a time), and right away when a member joins, levels up or gets a role.
rules.levelingOff: Leveling is off: levels do not change, so level rules only use the levels already stored.
rules.heading: Rules ({count} of {max})
rules.keepRoles: Turning a rule off or deleting it keeps the roles it already gave.
rules.full: This server has {max} rules, the most allowed. Delete one first.
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete the rule "{name}"? Roles it already gave stay.

preview.title: Dry run: {name}

wouldChange.one: Would change {count} member now: give the role to {add}, take it from {remove}. Nothing has been changed yet.
wouldChange.other: Would change {count} members now: give the role to {add}, take it from {remove}. Nothing has been changed yet.

savedOff.one: Saved switched off: nothing changes until you turn it on. If it were on now, it would change {count} member.
savedOff.other: Saved switched off: nothing changes until you turn it on. If it were on now, it would change {count} members.

preview.partial: Counted from {cached} of {total} members (the member list is still loading); the real run uses everyone.
preview.nextRun: Changes are made by the next run (within 10 minutes), at most {limit} per run.
preview.savedOffShort: The rule is saved switched off.

label.one: Joins and leaves per day, last {count} days: {joins} joins, {leaves} leaves
label.other: Joins and leaves per day, last {count} days: {joins} joins, {leaves} leaves

insights.title: Member insights
insights.intro: Who comes and goes, who is stuck without a role, who keeps getting cases.
insights.partial: Based on {cached} of {total} members: the member list is still loading. Reload in a minute.
insights.joinsSummary: {joined} joined · {left} left · net {net}. Days in UTC.
insights.nothingYet: Nothing counted yet: joins and leaves are recorded from now on.
insights.noRolesTitle: New members without a role after 24 hours
insights.noRolesHelp: Joined in the last 30 days, more than 24 hours ago, and still no role (bots left out). Often: never verified.
insights.noGuild: The bot cannot see the main server right now.
insights.offendersHelp: Members with two or more cases (removed, imported and test cases left out).

noOffenders.one: Nobody has two or more cases in the last {count} days.
noOffenders.other: Nobody has two or more cases in the last {count} days.

insights.inactiveOff: Not available: the only activity time Mewvo stores is the last time leveling gave a member XP, and leveling is off. Turn leveling on to start measuring; nothing is guessed here.

inactiveHelp.one: Activity = the last time leveling gave the member XP (messages that earn XP). Members in the server for less than {count} days and bots are left out.
inactiveHelp.other: Activity = the last time leveling gave the member XP (messages that earn XP). Members in the server for less than {count} days and bots are left out.

noRecord.one: {count} member has no leveling record at all (never earned XP, or before leveling was on) and is not listed.
noRecord.other: {count} members have no leveling record at all (never earned XP, or before leveling was on) and are not listed.

noInactive.one: Nobody with a leveling record has been quiet for {count} days.
noInactive.other: Nobody with a leveling record has been quiet for {count} days.

route.needDays: Give the number of days (a whole number).
route.loadError: The role rules could not be loaded (database not responding). Nothing was changed; reload to try again.
route.goneNotSaved: That rule no longer exists; nothing was saved.
route.full: This server already has {max} rules, the most allowed.
route.dryRunExpired: This dry run expired or was already used. Nothing was saved; run the dry run again.
route.savedOn: Rule "{name}" saved; the next run (within 10 minutes) applies it.
route.createdOn: Rule "{name}" created; the next run (within 10 minutes) applies it.
route.turnedOff: Rule "{name}" turned off. Roles it already gave stay.
route.deleted: Rule "{name}" deleted. Roles it already gave stay.
route.partFailed: Could not be loaded (database not responding). Reload to try again.
